usage: The word 廁所 (ci3 so2) refers to a place where people go to use the toilet or washroom.
It is commonly used to ask for the location of the bathroom or to describe bathroom facilities.
廁所 can be used in both formal and informal contexts, but it is more neutral than some slang terms.
You can combine it with verbs like 去 (heoi3) meaning 'to go', or 搞掂 (gaau2 dim6) meaning 'to clean'.
It can also appear in compound phrases such as 公共廁所 (gung1 gung6 ci3 so2) meaning 'public toilet'.
